item.title: IBM Connects Two Modular Cryogenic Systems for Quantum Computing
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has successfully joined and cooled down two cryogenic modules into a single environment. The new architecture is designed to scale into the modular, shared, and ultra-cold system required to link hundreds of quantum chips into a more powerful quantum computer capable of solving large problems.
